name: vllm_ggml_dequantize
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_ggml_dequantize.py. Dequantizes a GGML Q8_0 weight (quant_type=8) into an (m,n) tensor of the requested dtype via vLLM _custom_ops.ggml_dequantize. Q8_0 layout: each block of 32 values = 2-byte fp16 scale + 32 int8, i.e. 34 bytes; W has shape (rows, (n//32)*34) uint8. gen_inputs rebuilds a valid Q8_0 buffer vectorized (positive fp16 scales in ~[0.1,0.6) viewed as little-endian bytes + random int8 payload), matching the test's struct-packed data. quant_type, m, n are scalars; dtype is a string scalar resolved via getattr(torch,...). No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
